visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Use a form instead of a key listener
visualizerParams.problemDescription: A key listener adds the item on Enter. A form with a submit handler does this for free, and also works with a Go button on a phone keyboard. Use a form. The item must still be added on submit.

solution.explanation: A form turns Enter, a Go key or a button press into one submit event. That covers keyboards, phones and screen readers without testing key names.

checks.label: Adding Milk gives one item
checks.expr: type('#q', 'Milk') && (document.getElementById('f') ? submit('#f') : el('#q').dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', {key: 'Enter'}))) !== null && text('#l') === 'Milk'
